report: Dialysis-dependent chronic renal failure patient has widespread brown follicular hyperkeratotic plaques/papules and scalp hair loss. Biopsy shows dilated infundibula, keratin plugs, lichenoid reaction, perifollicular fibrosis, follicular plugging, lichenoid infiltrate, and vacuolar alteration. These findings strongly support acquired perforating disorder. Alternative diagnoses are unlikely given normal dioxin/sex hormones, no malignancy/collagen disease, and characteristic biopsy pattern. Despite no transepidermal elimination, this is the leading diagnosis.
